parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
Good morning. My name is Mark Bergen, and I’m the Human Resources Manager at Johnson Jones. I’m here to tell you what it’s like to work for one of the country’s best employers.

The company has 225 department stores and owns an additional 150 supermarkets. At our latest store opening, we had over 9,000 applicants for just 750 positions.

So, why do so many people want to work for us? Well, the first thing that attracts them isn’t just the salary, although it’s a little above average. It’s the idea of getting a massive 25% off everything—from washing machines to designer handbags. People are willing to put in long hours to get those kinds of perks.

Johnson Jones has been going strong for nearly 150 years and has outlived many of its strongest competitors. Of course, this has something to do with the high-quality products that we sell and our motto, “Better for Less,” which means customers know they are getting good value for their money. But we’re not alone in that. Where we are different is in our approach to making a profit. Other companies tend to think in the short term, while we always take a more strategic view, looking three to five years ahead.

The company isn’t owned by a family or shareholders. It’s a partnership, which means it’s owned by its full-time employees, who are all partners and have a share in the company. In return for the very generous benefits they get, they’re expected to put in extra effort and take an active role in running the company. This means they are involved in things like making decisions about pension contributions, for example.

Another very attractive reason for working with us is the annual bonus, which we receive as a percentage of our salary. Last year, it was 15%—about two months’ salary, which is pretty standard. It can go down to 8%, but that’s unusual, and a couple of times it’s even been above 20%. Some people use it to pay off loans, while others save it for a deposit on a house.

The most popular benefit for our partners is the subsidized holiday centers owned by the company. Once a year, partners can book a stay for up to two weeks. This benefit is available to everyone, from cleaners to directors, with a minimum of three months of service. After six months of service, partners are entitled to a further subsidy on the cost of their stay.

Let me give you an idea of what’s on offer at the holiday centers:

The Grange, the largest of our holiday centers, is used for conferences by the company, and the board of directors always has their annual meeting there. It’s all very informal, not like a normal conference center.

Meadow House is located in Kent, which is famous for its apples and other fruit, and it’s a large country house. What’s unusual about it is that, unlike other hotels, you have access to the kitchen, so it feels more like staying with a friend.

Coombe Manor is a working farm. There are loads of cows and sheep—none of which actually end up on our supermarket shelves. It’s a paradise for kids, as there’s plenty of space to run wild, and it also has an indoor pool. You can choose to stay in cottages or camp by the lake.

The Barn is where I recently celebrated my 25th wedding anniversary. You can rent the whole place out for a large group of up to 40 friends. We had all our food delivered from the nearest Johnson Jones supermarket, so there was no cooking to be done. Perfect. All that was missing was the spa, which should be opening next year.

The Stable is often hard to get into because it’s so popular. That’s partly because it’s right on the beach with beautiful sea views and is only an hour by train from London. It’s ideal for weekends. The company Sailing Club is located there, which was started by the company’s founder in 1885.

So, I’m sure you’ll all agree that there really is a lot to look forward to when working with us.

questions.question: What does Mark say first attracts people to work for Johnson Jones?

analyses.content: Mark 明确表示，吸引人们的第一件事不仅仅是薪水，而是获得 25% off（25%折扣）的员工福利。
Well, the first thing that attracts them isn’t just the salary... It’s the idea of getting a massive 25% off everything.
听到 salary（薪水）不要选 A，录音说 "isn’t just the salary"（不仅仅是薪水），重点在后面的折扣。

options.option: is focused on long term planning.
options.optionContent: is focused on long term planning.

questions.question: Mark says the company is one of the country's most successful retailers because it

analyses.content: Other companies tend to think in the short term, while we always take a more strategic view, looking three to five years ahead.
听到 value for money（物有所值）不要选 C，原文说 "we’re not alone in that"（我们不是唯一做到这一点的），这不能解释他们的独特成功。
Mark 说他们的不同之处在于采取 strategic view（战略眼光），往后看三到五年，即长期规划。

questions.question: Mark says that because Johnson Jones is a partnership, the staff

analyses.content: In return... they’re expected to put in extra effort and take an active role in running the company. This means they are involved in things like making decisions.
题目问的是 partnership 意味着什么，不要因为听到 benefits 就选 A 或 B，这里强调的是员工的投入和责任。
因为是合伙制，员工被期望在运营公司中通过做决策（making decisions）来承担 active role（积极的角色/责任）。

questions.question: What is the typical annual bonus that partners receive?

analyses.content: Last year, it was 15%—about two months’ salary, which is pretty standard.
8% 是 "unusual"（不寻常的低），20% 是 "a couple of times"（偶发的高），都不是 typical（典型的）。
Mark 说去年的奖金是 15%，这被描述为 "pretty standard"（相当标准/典型）。

questions.question: To qualify for the leisure and holiday facilities, partners must have worked for the company for

analyses.content: This benefit is available to everyone... with a minimum of three months of service.
Six months（六个月）是指获得 "further subsidy"（进一步补贴）的门槛，而不是获得资格的门槛，不要混淆。
录音明确指出，这项福利对所有人开放，最低服务期限为 three months（三个月）。

analyses.content: The Grange 被用于公司的会议，且董事会（board of directors，即高级管理层）总是在这里开年会。
The Grange... is used for conferences by the company, and the board of directors always has their annual meeting there.
只要听到 "conferences" 和 "board of directors" 就能对应到 senior management。
...unlike other hotels, you have access to the kitchen, so it feels more like staying with a friend.
听到 "access to the kitchen" 和 "staying with a friend" 就要联想到家庭环境。
Meadow House 允许客人使用厨房，感觉更像是 staying with a friend（住在朋友家），对应选项中的 "someone's home"。
It’s a paradise for kids, as there’s plenty of space to run wild...
听到 "kids" 和 "cows and sheep" 就可以直接对应 families with children。
Coombe Manor 有很多动物且空间很大，被称为 paradise for kids（孩子的天堂），非常适合家庭。
The Barn is where I recently celebrated my 25th wedding anniversary. You can rent the whole place out for a large group.
听到 "celebrated" 和 "large group" 即可锁定答案，不要被提到的 spa（明年才开）干扰。
Mark 最近在 The Barn 庆祝了他的 wedding anniversary（结婚纪念日），适合大型聚会，对应 celebrations。
That’s partly because it’s... only an hour by train from London. It’s ideal for weekends.
听到 "weekends" 直接对应 short breaks，不要因为提到 sailing club 就去找运动相关的干扰项。
The Stable 离伦敦只有一小时路程，非常适合 weekends（周末），对应选项中的 short breaks（短假）。
